package student

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"testing"
)

type nbaReader struct {
	s      domain.NextActionSnapshot
	reads  int
	mutate bool
}

func (r *nbaReader) ReadNextActionSnapshot(_ context.Context, _ string) (domain.NextActionSnapshot, error) {
	r.reads++
	s := r.s
	if r.mutate && r.reads > 1 {
		p := *s.SelectedPath
		p.Version++
		s.SelectedPath = &p
	}
	return s, nil
}

type nbaRuntime struct {
	p   domain.PracticeExecutionProjection
	err error
}

func (r nbaRuntime) ReadExecutionProjection(context.Context, string, string) (domain.PracticeExecutionProjection, error) {
	return r.p, r.err
}
func TestNextActionExactRuntimeBindingAndStaleSnapshot(t *testing.T) {
	id := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	b := domain.PracticeLearningActionBinding{StudentID: id, TaskInstanceID: id, LearningActionID: "action", TaskRevisionID: "revision", TaskRevisionDigest: "digest", LearningPathID: "path", LearningPathItemID: "item", LifecycleStatus: domain.PracticeLearningActionOpen}
	s := domain.NextActionSnapshot{StudentID: id, SelectedPath: &domain.StudentLearningPath{ID: "path", Status: domain.LearningPathStatusActive, Version: 1, Items: []domain.LearningPathItem{{ID: "item", ReferenceType: "practice", Status: domain.LearningPathItemInProgress}}}, Bindings: []domain.PracticeLearningActionBinding{b}}
	p := domain.PracticeExecutionProjection{Schema: "practice-execution-projection.v1", StudentID: id, TaskInstanceID: id, LearningActionID: b.LearningActionID, TaskRevisionID: b.TaskRevisionID, TaskRevisionDigest: b.TaskRevisionDigest, LearningPathID: b.LearningPathID, LearningPathItemID: b.LearningPathItemID, Status: "READY", SuggestedAction: "RESUME_PRACTICE", AvailableActions: []string{"RESUME_PRACTICE"}, ReasonCode: "workspace_active", Version: "v1"}
	for _, c := range []struct {
		name   string
		mutate func(*domain.PracticeExecutionProjection)
		stale  bool
		err    error
		ready  bool
	}{{name: "exact", ready: true}, {name: "foreign_student", mutate: func(p *domain.PracticeExecutionProjection) { p.StudentID = "foreign" }}, {name: "wrong_requirement", mutate: func(p *domain.PracticeExecutionProjection) { p.RequirementID = "different" }}, {name: "wrong_revision", mutate: func(p *domain.PracticeExecutionProjection) { p.TaskRevisionDigest = "different" }}, {name: "unavailable", err: errors.New("offline")}, {name: "I_state_changes", stale: true}, {name: "invalid_primary", mutate: func(p *domain.PracticeExecutionProjection) { p.SuggestedAction = "LLM_DECISION" }}} {
		t.Run(c.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			r := &nbaReader{s: s, mutate: c.stale}
			projection := p
			if c.mutate != nil {
				c.mutate(&projection)
			}
			got, err := (NextActionResolver{Reader: r, Runtime: nbaRuntime{projection, c.err}}).Handle(context.Background(), id)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if c.ready {
				if got.Primary == nil || got.Primary.Kind != "RESUME_PRACTICE" {
					t.Fatal(got)
				}
			} else if got.Status != "WAITING" || got.Primary != nil {
				t.Fatal(got)
			}
			if c.stale && got.ReasonCode != "state_changed" {
				t.Fatal(got)
			}
		})
	}
}
